moa.t: Sustained tonic uterine contraction via α-adrenergic and serotonin receptors, vasoconstriction

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Ergometrine, IM, 0.5 mg. or a combination of oxytocin, IM, 5 units and ergometrine, IM, 0.5 mg.

Once reduction is achieved, give ergometrine 0.5 mg IM and oxytocin 20 units in one litre Sodium Chloride 0,9% at 240 mL/hour. · Do not remove the hand from the uterine cavity until a firm uterine contraction is felt.
Consider adding ergometrine 0.5 mg IM as a single dose unless the mother is hypertensive or has cardiac disease. · Admit the patient or transfer from CHC to hospital.

Do not give ergometrine in the third stage; instead use oxytocin 10 units intramuscularly. • In women with NYHA grade II dyspnoea or more, consider the use of furosemide 40 mg intravenously after delivery of the baby.

cautions.t: Store in the fridge, protected from light

adverse_effects.t: Nausea, vomiting, hypertension, headache, coronary and peripheral vasospasm
